title: Finite product generation of affine ring-sheaf pushout sections
statement: Let f:U → X be a morphism of schemes. Put A=f_*O_U, ρ:O_X → A its structure map, IA=f⁻¹A, r₀:f⁻¹O_X → O_U its adjoint structure map, and t₀=f⁻¹ρ. Let B be a commutative-ring sheaf on U, b:O_U → B and t:IA → B making a pushout of r₀ and t₀. For an open V of X put W=f⁻¹V, D=Γ(X,V), C=Γ(U,W), and δ=t_W ∘ η_{A,V}:C → B(W). Assume f is affine and V is affine. Every z in B(W) equals a finite sum of b_W(c_i)δ(d_i), with c_i,d_i in C. The maps are the explicit ones of [stage3-affine-pushout-ring-section-map]. This states existence of product presentations only, without uniqueness or relations.

source.place: Tag 01SB affine reduction; Tags 01I9, 01IA and 01HV for affine pullback sections

proof.text: The regular A-module, restricted to O_X, is the quasi-coherent module f_*O_U, by affine qcqs pushforward.

Apply scalar-extension cancellation to this regular module. The inverse-image regular module is the regular IA-module. The balanced maps z tensor a ↦ z*t(a) and z ↦ z tensor 1 identify its extension with the regular B-module before and after sheafification. The unit of the resulting module comparison maps d to t(η(d)).

W is affine; the affine pullback section comparison supplies a surjective linear map C tensor_D C → B(W) sending c tensor d to b(c)δ(d). Choose a preimage of z for the proof of existence. Tensor induction writes it as a finite sum of pure tensors: empty list for zero, singleton for a pure tensor, concatenation for addition. Additivity yields the asserted finite product presentation. This proof makes no assertion about injectivity or relations.
